evidencePolicy: Derived from tracked file bytes, executable verifiers and lexical code queries. Markdown, runbook status and QC labels are recorded as claims, never as evidence. Gaps disappear when their predicate stops matching.

gaps.summary: renderFiles dispatches 7 format branches in a fixed if/else chain; adding a format or swapping an adapter requires editing core, the schema enum, desktop UI and release verification.
Product modules embed programs of 25+ lines in template literals; they bypass typecheck, lint and unit tests and are emitted into every release.
Core runtime loads fonts, lockfiles or node_modules from the legacy template tree; the managed pipeline cannot run without template/.
Mermaid, Excalidraw and Marp visuals are rasterised only inside the Remotion path; HTML, Office, PDF and raster outputs lose diagrams unless video is also requested.
ContentIR/RenderSpec have no layer, tile, grid or live-state atoms; visuals are one optional diagram per section and every adapter hard-codes its own layout.
No workflow runs release-verify, runbook-verify or qc-index against projects/, so stale releases, indexes and status claims merge silently.
Speech synthesis runs as a blocking subprocess that writes one WAV; there is no provider interface, streaming chunk contract or incremental caption seam.
Core modules no test imports directly; transitive coverage only exercises happy paths of callers.
Documentation points at repository paths that are not tracked (gitignored, moved or never committed).
Top-level helpers declared independently in more than one core module; fixes must be applied in parallel.
evidence: slug: library/integrations/copilot/desktop.ts, library/integrations/copilot/helpers.ts, packages/core/src/account-intake.ts, packages/core/src/adapters.ts, packages/core/src/media-remotion.ts

gaps.summary: Skill, agent and plugin changes do not trigger core validation; manifests, frontmatter and discovery parity are never checked.
Core-managed projects without a durable GenerationRequest cannot reconstruct intent or defaults.
Skill folders with metadata.json but no SKILL.md; registry classifies them as automations or assets, not skills.
Environment variables alter product behaviour (engine, models, thresholds, paths) without being captured in RenderSpec, VoiceSpec or the release digest.
Contract fields that no product module references outside schema validation; they are accepted, digested and shipped but never drive behaviour.
Complete superseded release trees kept beside the current release; consumers can pick a stale package.
Tracked artifacts and docs contain absolute user-profile paths.
